text: A while loop checks its condition before each iteration, so its body may not run at all if the condition is false at the start.
A for loop can count down as well as up, and its counter can change by any step size.
A do-while loop runs its body once before checking the condition, so the body always executes at least once.
An expression produces a value, while a statement performs an action and does not necessarily produce a value.
In Java, arguments are passed by value, so reassigning a parameter inside a method does not change the caller's variable.
A constructor has no return type and has the same name as its class.
A variable declared inside a method is local to that method and cannot be accessed from other methods of the class.
Array indices in Java and C# start at 0, so the first element is at index 0.
Console input in C# is read as a string, so it must be converted, for example with int.Parse, before doing arithmetic.
The tangent function is undefined where cosine equals zero, such as at pi/2 plus any integer multiple of pi.
The Pythagorean identity is sin^2(x) + cos^2(x) = 1.
Cosecant is the reciprocal of sine, and secant is the reciprocal of cosine.
Complementary angles sum to 90 degrees and supplementary angles sum to 180 degrees.
The average rate of change of a function over an interval [a, b] equals (f(b) - f(a)) / (b - a).

concept: average rate of change: difference quotients
text: The difference quotient (f(x+h)-f(x))/h gives the average rate of change over an interval of width h, not the exact instantaneous rate.
IPv6 addresses are longer than IPv4 addresses, 128 bits versus 32 bits, and support far more devices.
A WAN covers a larger geographic area than a LAN.
Symmetric encryption uses the same key for both encryption and decryption.
A white-hat hacker tests systems for vulnerabilities with permission in order to improve their security.
RAM is volatile memory, so it loses its contents when the computer is powered off.
The operating system is system software that manages the hardware and provides services to application programs.
Artificial intelligence refers to machines performing tasks that normally require human intelligence, without requiring consciousness or self-awareness.
Pattern recognition in computational thinking means identifying similarities between problems so that a solution can be reused.
Abstraction means hiding unnecessary details and focusing on the information that matters for the problem.
An algorithm must be unambiguous, with each step precisely defined.
SQL is a declarative language where you specify what data you want rather than how to retrieve it step by step.
DDL commands such as CREATE, ALTER and DROP define the structure of tables, while SELECT is used to query data.
In a relational DBMS, data is organized into tables made of rows and columns.

Most HTML elements require a closing tag, although a few empty elements such as
and do not have one.
The href attribute of an anchor tag specifies the URL that the link points to.
HTML headings range from <h1> to <h6>, with <h1> being the largest.
Cloud computing means storing data and running services on remote servers that are accessed over the internet.
Data stored in the cloud still needs protection such as encryption and access control.
An if statement can be used on its own without an else block.
In C#, a switch statement can compare strings as well as integer values.
The continue keyword skips the rest of the current iteration and moves on to the next iteration of the loop.
A method can have a void return type, in which case it does not return a value.
A class can contain both fields and methods.
In Java and C#, an array has a fixed length once created; to grow it you must create a new, larger array and copy the elements.
In Java, a string cannot be multiplied by an integer with the * operator; repetition requires a method such as repeat() or a loop.
Sine and cosine only take values between -1 and 1.
The inverse tangent function returns angles between -pi/2 and pi/2.
In function notation f(x), the expression f(x) means the value of the function f at the input x.
UDP does not guarantee reliable or ordered delivery of packets, unlike TCP.
DNS translates domain names into IP addresses.
HTTP is a protocol used to transfer web pages between web servers and browsers.
Narrow AI is designed to perform one specific task and cannot handle every intellectual task a human can.
Computational thinking is a problem-solving approach that can be applied without a computer, including on paper.
In a boolean comparison, the operator == checks equality, while = assigns a value.
The inner condition of a nested if statement is only checked when the outer condition is true.
The break statement exits the loop entirely, while continue skips the current iteration and continues with the next one.
A for loop can start counting at any number, not only at 0.
A while loop re-checks its condition before every iteration.
An if statement can test any boolean condition, including comparisons of strings.
In an if-elif-else chain, only the first branch whose condition is true is executed.
range(1, 5) in Python produces the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 and excludes the upper bound.
In nested loops, the inner loop runs through all of its iterations for each single iteration of the outer loop.
In Python you do not declare a variable's data type; the type is determined by the value assigned.
Dynamic typing means a variable can refer to values of different types at different times.
Dividing two integers in Python with / returns a float; for example, 7 / 2 gives 3.5.
A variable declared inside a function in Python is local to that function and cannot be accessed outside it.
The input() function in Python always returns a string, even when the user types a number.
In Python, the slice s[1:4] includes indices 1, 2 and 3 but excludes index 4.
In Python, strings are immutable, so assigning to s[0] raises an error.
Defining a function with def does not run it; the function body runs only when the function is called.
In Python, variable names cannot start with a digit.
The and operator returns true only if both of its operands are true.
The not operator returns the opposite boolean value of its operand.
The operator <= returns true when the left value is less than or equal to the right value.
The modulus operator % returns the remainder of a division.
Floor division // rounds the result down to the nearest whole number.
Converting a float to an int in Python with int() truncates toward zero instead of rounding.
A class is a blueprint, and an object is a specific instance created from that class.
A class is defined once, and its methods can be called many times without recreating the class.
A class can be used as a data type for variables and parameters.
Each object created from a class has its own copy of the instance fields.
A constructor is called automatically when an object is created with new.
If a constructor does not set a field, the field still exists and holds its default value, such as 0 or null.
In Java and C#, methods within a class can be defined in any order, before or after the main method.
Parameters are the variables listed in a method's definition, and arguments are the values passed in when the method is called.
An optional parameter has a default value, so it can be omitted when the method is called.
A boolean expression evaluates to either true or false.
A sentinel value is a special value that signals the end of input and causes the loop to stop.
Input validation means checking that user input meets the required conditions and rejecting or re-requesting invalid input.
An infinite loop never stops on its own because its condition never becomes false.
A two-dimensional array can store values of any one data type, such as strings or objects, not only numbers.
In Java, comparing two arrays with == checks whether they are the same object; Arrays.equals compares their contents.
Linear search does not require the array to be sorted.
You can use a loop to go through the characters of a string one at a time.
Decomposition means breaking a large problem into smaller, more manageable parts.
Decomposition in computing means breaking a program into smaller parts, such as separate functions.
Pattern recognition means finding similarities among problems so that common solutions can be reused.
Abstraction means hiding unnecessary details so that the user can focus on what is important.
Higher levels of abstraction hide more of the low-level hardware detail from the user.
Computational thinking can be performed by people as well as by computers.
An algorithm must be a precise, unambiguous sequence of steps.
In a flowchart, a diamond shape represents a decision, while an oval represents the start or end.
Artificial intelligence means machines performing tasks that normally require human intelligence, not machines that are conscious.
In machine learning, classification predicts a category, while regression predicts a continuous numeric value.
Private IP addresses are not routable on the public internet.
The Internet Protocol does not guarantee that packets arrive in order or without loss; TCP provides that reliability.
HTTPS encrypts data during transfer, while HTTP sends data in plain text.
DNS converts a domain name into an IP address.
When data is sent over a network, it is split into smaller packets that can travel separately.
A router forwards each packet toward its destination based on its address rather than sending it to every device.
The OSI model has seven layers, each with a different function.
UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee reliable or ordered delivery, unlike TCP.
Encryption converts data into an unreadable form that can be decrypted by someone who has the correct key.
Symmetric encryption uses a single shared key, while asymmetric encryption uses a public and private key pair.
In asymmetric encryption, one key encrypts the message and a different, paired key decrypts it.
Phishing is a social engineering attack that uses deceptive messages to trick people into revealing information such as passwords.
Social engineering attacks rely on manipulating or tricking people rather than on breaking encryption.
A firewall monitors and filters network traffic according to security rules.
The CPU executes program instructions, while long-term storage of files is the job of storage devices such as hard drives.
RAM is temporary working memory, while a hard drive provides long-term storage, so they serve different purposes.
An operating system is essential system software that manages the computer's hardware and runs applications.
The operating system manages memory, processes, files and hardware devices.
An AND gate outputs 1 only when all of its inputs are 1.
An AND gate produces an output of 1 only when both inputs are 1.
In binary, each position represents a power of 2.
In the decimal system, each position to the left represents a power of 10.
A DBMS stores data in an organized, structured way and manages access to it.
DML commands such as INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE change the data in tables, while CREATE TABLE is a DDL command.
A key advantage of a DBMS is that it reduces data redundancy and inconsistency.
HTML is a markup language used to structure the content of web pages, not a language for calculations.
The alt attribute of an img tag provides alternative text that describes the image.
CSS is used to define the appearance and layout of a web page.
JavaScript and Java are different programming languages despite their similar names.
Cloud computing means storing and accessing data and programs over the internet on remote servers.
A benefit of cloud computing is that it allows you to scale resources up or down as needed.
In the SaaS model, the provider manages the underlying servers and hardware, and the customer simply uses the software.
The tangent function is undefined at angles where cosine is zero, such as pi/2.
The sine of an angle always lies between -1 and 1.
Cosecant is the reciprocal of sine, and secant is the reciprocal of cosine.
One full revolution around a circle is equal to 2 pi radians.
A radian is the angle formed by an arc whose length equals the radius, about 57.3 degrees.
